question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
answer: Full-time employees accrue **20 days of PTO per calendar year**, credited monthly at 1.67 days per completed month of service. [C1] Employees receive **10 paid sick days per year**, separate from PTO. [C3] Jury duty is paid in full for the duration of service. [C2]
